keysAndJobs.newJob: One intake-evidence job type through existing dispatcher/jobs, not another broker or authority.
keysAndJobs.why: Bounded closing pass needs both sides and source completion; retries must not run a provider again.
keysAndJobs.enqueueKey: stable UUID from caseId + sourceId/revision/hash + reader + accepted result + keyProfileHash
matchKey: caseId/siteId + namespace + declared key kind + typed literal value + exact-key/1 profile hash
No lowercasing, transliteration, punctuation stripping, number coercion or filename/name similarity.
No address-only or party-name match; names indexed only as present, never a person lookup.
Officer chooses map source field and table source-column id; document quote must contain that exact literal.
Map sourceKey is an original feature locator, not an official ULPIN or necessarily a registry identifier.
First version is exact literal identity only; broader normalisation/spatial linking is explicitly deferred.
candidatePin: anchor item, package id/revision/review fingerprint, feature id/sourceKey, map source revision/hash
table raw/mapping job input hashes, accepted slot/raw/result hashes, schema/recipe/converter hashes
table sheet, header rows, physical sourceRow, positional column id, cell state, literal/quote hash
document source/job/fence/input/result hashes, part UUID/text hash, native unit hash/page/character spans
durability: One additive migration beside intake tables: key index and immutable proposal/coverage manifests.
Foreign keys point to existing originals/slots/jobs/targets; no copied registry or imported-part forgery.
Indexed lookup per key, symmetric on late anchor arrival; closing pass finds duplicates/conflicts.
Existing transactional publication/event pattern; SSE contains ids/counts, never literal rows or source text.
Bound processing to existing source limits; per-transaction chunks <=16 rows or12 selected document parts.
operationKeys: receive: client UUID per original; retain/probe/raw/mapping each deterministic derivative UUID
close: source-result manifest hash + key profile + anchor inventory hash
stage4: confirmationId + targetId + linkManifestHash + draft/amend/review/commit operation name
snapshot/plan/confirm/execute/card: existing intakeRunKey with final reviewed record revision pinned
keysAndJobs.replay: Same key + same input replays; changed digest refuses409; job publication uses existing attempt fence.

outcomes.denominator: One eligible row or quoted native part/key assertion, not one field and not one building.
outcomes.matched: Exactly one target, closed coverage, no duplicate-key or cited fact conflict; still a proposal.
outcomes.no_match: Closed coverage and zero exact targets, including explicit missing key; never unread rows.
outcomes.several: More than one target for the exact key; all candidates retained, none selected.
outcomes.conflicting: Duplicate key assertions or incompatible selected values/targets; alternatives remain quoted.
outcomes.precedence: conflicting > several > matched > no_match; each eligible assertion belongs to exactly one count.
outcomes.coverage: Separate read/eligible/keyless/unread/failed counts; partial job means totals incomplete, not zero.
outcomes.questionUnit: Group by source layout/key/conflict group, not repeat a question for every identical row.
outcomes.cardCounts: Show cited assertion count separately from records/card count; deduplicate exact citation pins.

officerQuestions: Which literal sheet and header rows? Which column and map field mean the same identifier namespace?
What does a key mean and where is it scoped? Do not invent a key when these sources share none.
What are issuer/origin/licence/privacy states? Unknown provenance permits local reading only.
For several/no-match/conflicting: select an exact target with both citations, reject, or explicitly exclude.
For G+41/G+42, units or floor meanings: retain alternatives and unknowns; no winner chosen by a model.
Has all relevant input been read? Confirm named exclusions and their reasons, or keep targets preparing.
Confirm listed targets, exact rows/pages/quotes and card preview; acknowledgement explicitly covers citations.
confirmationPins: Retained original manifest sealed by ids/revisions/hashes/byte sizes; included and explicitly excluded sources.
Actor/access/site context, expected target set and candidate feature pins; package review fingerprints.
Source reading coverage + job/result/slot/fence pins; layout/recipe/schema/key-profile versions and hashes.
Exact accepted link proposal ids/digest with table row/cell or document part/page/quote selectors.
All conflict/ambiguity decisions/reasons; append-only citation authorisation and expected record mapping.
Officer acknowledgement, reason/expiry and stable keys; no right or issuance authorisation.
Post-record record revision/body hash derives from pinned package commit and is stored as stage3 artefact.
Stage4 adds only selected citations; unexpected findings/movement stops target, no implied fresh approval.
After correction commit, replace target's record pin with returned revision/body hash before snapshot5.
If no accepted attachments, stage4 stores explicit no_additions and leaves revision1; never an implicit skip.
oneConfirmationSequence: Receive/probe/read/map/close links automatically; ask only unresolved selections or provenance/layout questions.
Officer answers recipe questions through existing approval, then one batch confirmation authorises recording.
Run stage3 commits map packages; stage4 maps pinned feature target to its resulting recorded id/revision.
Stage4 creates correction, appends citations, requests technical review and commits under that confirmation.
No per-row confirm, no second officer press for routine exact additions; errors remain stopped and visible.
Snapshot5 uses latest reviewed revision (often2); stage6 remains not_applicable for exterior building identity.
Plan7 includes feature and accepted row/native-page quotes; confirm/execute/card8 uses same authorisation.
Card prints source name/revision/hash, sheet/row or page/part locator and exact excerpt, with packet link.
Do not label source statements as ownership, dimensions or verified registry facts; printable profile limits stay.
readinessAndLateArrival: Any possibly relevant evidence item still reading -> preparing for that source-dependent target group.
Closed exact single proposals with approved recipe and no questions may be ready; plural/conflict needs_answer.
No shared key is an honest no_match; may confirm explicit exclusion, never auto-invent an anchor.
Waiting key proposals are reconsidered symmetrically on anchor arrival; order must not change final outcome.
New source is outside an existing sealed confirmation. Never silently extend its scope or overwrite a card.
Late file prepares a citation-only correction confirmation for affected recorded targets, no package recommit.
Late correction confirmation is additive: confirm already recorded targets, not E1's uncommitted packages.
Only citing targets re-pin; produce new packet/card after review, preserve old artefacts/history.

rules: Table16 MiB/2000 data rows/256 columns/1-5 headers; no million-row or large workbook claim.
Original document16 MiB, native10 MiB/250000 chars/10000 parts/4096chars per part/result4 MiB.
OCR explicit local selection page1-8, one global OCR;120s document job/90s local OCR budget unchanged.
Raw/mapping/document histories, active jobs, memory/disk reservations and original-upload quotas unchanged.
Confirmation <=100 targets/100 packages; existing draft-target cap2000 and snapshot scope limits stay.
Originals immutable, exact-source/actor/site checks, stale409, accepted attempt fences and object hashes stay.
Table regional units remain needs_input without sourced factor; unknown/formula cells never acquire values.
No provider/GPU required; existing case_original teacher refusal and global gateway money/privacy guards stay.
Large retained but unsupported table/PDF remains kept-not-read with reason; no size-limit bypass.
No stage4 bulk evidence write to unlisted targets; map package recording behaviour remains as E1 defines.
